alreadyImplemented.evidence: Enterprise Object Registry, Live Object Status Layer, persistent object storage, Mission Control object views.
Executive Council, executive agents, Executive Offices, AI Workforce Operations, attention queue, communications, calendar.
CEO Cockpit, Digital Headquarters Lobby, workspace rail, command bar, PMO, strategy, valuation, knowledge, and platform views.
Second Balance Sheet metrics and Digital Enterprise Valuation foundation exist as internal estimate records.
Local JSON persistence, backup status, release metadata, and storage health are operational.

partiallyImplemented.gap: DTA monitoring exists, but lifecycle governance, templates, and enterprise formation workflows need expansion.
Portfolio management is represented in roadmap data but not yet operational as a management layer.
Exchange concept exists in PMO, but listing criteria, exchange governance, and market mechanics are not implemented.
Agent Knowledge Repository exists; it now needs explicit Knowledge, IP, Patents, and Research positioning.
Revenue streams are modeled in this capability but not yet connected to CRM, finance, contracts, or customer workflows.

notYetImplemented.reason: Requires agent hiring, performance, governance, packaging, and customer-facing marketplace rules.
Requires legal, compliance, regulated workflows, external market data, and audited valuation controls.
Requires multi-enterprise data boundaries, tenant model, integrations, security, and governance.
Requires customer model, contracts, pricing, onboarding, billing, and support workflows.

recommendedFutureCapabilities: Persistent Write API & Governance Audit Ledger
